info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts Externally Processed Invoices API
Creates an externally processed invoice in Appzen with optional validation checks

items.docs: This will create a new invoice in AppZen referred by uuid. This invoice will be processed further by AppZen for extraction and validation (optionally, based on header input). When there already exists an invoice (invoice_id), then the operation is an update (the `status` would be `UPDATED` in this case).
